question.text: A vessel with water is placed on a weighing pan and it reads $600 \mathrm{~g}$. Now a ball of mass $40 \mathrm{~g}$ and density $0.80 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}$ is sunk into the water with a pin of negligible volume, as shown in figure keeping it sunk. The weighing pan will show a reading

solution.text:
Volume of ball $=\frac{40}{0.8}=50 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$

Downthrust on water $=50 \mathrm{~g}$. Therefore reading is $650 \mathrm{~g}$.
